text:
alex: Heads-up from support: customers seeing mismatch between SDK HTTP codes and Console badge during short incidents. Example: SDK gets 429, Console shows red outage for same minute.

pat: Likely the same pattern: router falls back to cheaper model (degraded) then later the tenant quota triggers a reject. Two signals in one session.

sina: Current wiring: telemetry emits separate events (fallback, quota_reject). Console uses last event in the minute and sets badge. SDK maps the first HTTP response. So UX diverges.

pm-lee: Customers need a single action guidance: "retry now" vs "contact support/upgrade". We should standardize a small surface for programmatic clients and the Console.

sdk-maya: SDK owners want code-first signals. Proposal: add a compact header x-rd-status with canonical states: retryable|degraded|blocked and metadata like source and retry_after. Keep HTTP status aligned with the most actionable state seen during the request handling.

alex: Concrete mapping suggestion:
- quota.block -> 429 + x-rd-status=status=retryable;source=quota;retry_after=30
- fallback_to_lower_model -> 206 + x-rd-status=status=degraded;source=router;model=tuned-small
- reject_after_fallback -> 503 + x-rd-status=status=blocked;source=router
- account_limit -> 403 + x-rd-status=status=blocked;source=account

pat: Important: avoid 200-with-warning. Use non-2xx when caller needs to take action. 206 for altered outputs (fallback) is useful because it signals non-success without implying full failure.

sina: Telemetry change: emit rd.failure_severity with severity=blocked|degraded|retryable and bucket=quota|router|model. Dashboards and alerting can use the label to align with Console.

pm-lee: Console rule: show the highest-severity state across the sliding window for a route (blocked > degraded > retryable > ok). Badge text and CTA should be derived from that single state.

sdk-maya: SDK plan: parse x-rd-status into rdStatus object, expose shouldRetry boolean (true only for retryable), and helper backoff util. Bump minor version and include migration notes.

alex: Rollout plan: feature-flag headers+telemetry first (no behavior change), validate for 24h, then flip SDK mapping behind flag, run integration tests simulating fallback->reject sequences, then enable Console derivation and update runbooks.

deploy-bot: scheduled: headers-flag -> staging 04:00 UTC tomorrow. Auto-promote after 24h healthy window.

sina: I'll draft the RFC with header schema, examples, telemetry labels, and recommended Prometheus/ES mappings.

pm-lee: I'll prepare the Console copy + runbook templates once RFC lands. Need a short troubleshooting table mapping header+http -> user action.

sdk-maya: Will open SDK PR with parsing + samples, and tag this thread when ready.

alex: Thanks, team. This should reduce confused tickets. I'll watch staging smoke and report results.
